sections.label: 38-3405 - Genetic counseling, defined.
sections.text:
Chapter 38 - Health Occupations and Professions
38-3405 - Genetic counseling, defined.

38-3405.
Genetic counseling, defined.
Genetic counseling means the provision of services described in section 38-3415.
Source
Laws 2012, LB831, § 5.

sections.label: 38-3406 - Genetic counseling intern, defined.
sections.text:
38-3406.
Genetic counseling intern, defined.
Genetic counseling intern means a student enrolled in a genetic counseling program accredited by the national genetic counseling board.
Source
Laws 2012, LB831, § 6.

sections.label: 38-3407 - Genetic counselor, defined.
sections.text:
Chapter 38 - Health Occupations and Professions
38-3407 - Genetic counselor, defined.

38-3407.
Genetic counselor, defined.
Genetic counselor means an individual licensed under the Genetic Counseling Practice Act.
Source
Laws 2012, LB831, § 7.
